data.name: Chrissy
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Boulder House

You wake up trapped in a sprawling mansion filled with gym gear, protein shakes, and locked doors. Monitoring the halls is Chrissy, a paranoid, hyper-muscled parody who patrols the house looking for intruders. Your goal is simple: find the tools, solve the locks, and get out.

5 Spanks and You're Out

Every time Chrissy catches you, he gives you an unforgettable, humiliating spanking with a massive wooden paddle. You wake up on the next day with the house reset, but the clock is ticking. You have exactly 5 attempts to escape before he finally loses his patience and ends your run for good.

Watch the Cameras (But Don't Get Greedy)

You have access to a security monitor to track Chrissy’s movements. Use it to map his patrol routes and plan your next move. But beware: Chrissy hates technology. Stare at the monitors for too long, and he will track your signal, enter a blind rage, and hunt you down instantly.

Infinite Replayability & Challenge

No two runs are the same. Every time you get a full game over (after 5 failed attempts), all puzzle items randomize into completely new locations. Choose from multiple difficulty modes to test your stealth skills, speedrun your escape, or turn the mansion into an absolute nightmare.

Key Features:

  • Caseoh Friendly: Kindergarten level puzz-"activities" to escape.

  • Classic Escape Gameplay: Scavenge for keys, fuses, and strange tools to unlock your path to freedom.

  • 5-Day Life System: Balance your risks carefully—you only get 5 attempts per run.

  • Randomized Spawns: Item locations fully reshuffle on every fresh reset to keep you guessing.

  • Risk vs. Reward Tracking: Balance your camera usage to stay safe without triggering Chrissy's aggro state.

  • Multiple Difficulties: Adjust Chrissy's speed, aggression, and hearing to match your playstyle.

An upcoming Granny-like game made for Caseoh. 

"Why can't Chris Redfield just be in here walking around in just a maid outfit with bunny ears on, with a paddle, and every time I get too loud, he just beats me?" - Caseoh

This is my first real game, I hope you have fun :)

data.short_description: Chrissy Boulder, a serial spanker, has captured you in his house. You must escape. Explore the house, find tools, gear, weapons and most importantly a way out. He will be lurking in the shadows. Make too much noise and he will hunt you down. If he catches you he will spank you with his paddle.
